decision.reason: The current complete report explicitly reanalyses the same ADNI baseline temporal-lobe phenotype/data stream as Stein2010a and compares GRIN2B/NRXN3 association evidence against its published findings, using LASSO SNP selection and joint gene tests. The recovered complete Stein manuscript establishes original baseline provenance, temporal phenotype and named associations. Original N742 and current N729 reflect differing selection/covariates; exact individual intersection is unverified, but no new ADNI wave supplies the retest. Reanalysing the original observations under an alternative gene specification can qualify even when method development and discovering additional genes are the main aims. The independent Brisbane MACROD2 component repeats a new within-paper discovery and does not turn the Stein retest into new-data replication. Joint gene tests are not claimed to recover marginal SNP coefficients. Original NRXN3 is a liberal P<1e-5 association, despite the current summary describing genome-wide significance; that contradiction is preserved. The dependent original binding and separate reproduction axes require necessary updated review; no outcome is inferred solely from stronger p values.

decision.reason: The full paper evaluates a locally implemented Tutorials curriculum, immediate versus one-year gains and teacher implementation. It names earlier empirical Tutorials successes in its Introduction and preserves them as contrary context. Its specific source-linked comparison to shipped Engelhardt/Beichner2004 is a 49% compound-sample performance benchmark for the DIRECT instrument, not a retest of that instrument paper's psychometric validation finding. Current research questions target local curriculum effectiveness/retention and experienced versus novice implementation; no earlier study's corresponding effect is specified as an empirical replication target. Curriculum fidelity and internal next-year repetition alone do not establish such a target. This negative rests on the actual source-specific instrument-versus-curriculum relationship and current chosen questions, not merely a new population, novel main aim or absence of a causal control.
